purpose: One-off native Cocoa accessibility latency comparison during a real wide-CSV unique operation; not an external CUA end-to-end test.

method.worker: One ThreadPoolExecutor worker runs the unmodified real core.prepare_result(source, Selection(), distinct="n0", cancel=Cancellation()), then reads/verifies its result and cleans its scratch directory.
method.native_view: Real CsvTable/PageModel, 200 buffered rows and 4000 columns, 900x500 window; table current cell (0, 0); no pinned columns.
method.activation: Baseline had verified table.hasFocus()=True at initial idle/busy focus sample. Direct candidate explicitly set the Qt active window and asserted table.hasFocus() before starting; all three busy focus samples remained True.
method.gil: A ctypes.CDLL call releases the Python GIL once around an entire compiled Objective-C recursive Cocoa walk; Qt/PySide callbacks then reacquire it normally while the real Python worker competes. No global switch interval or worker yield changes.
native_calls: NSWindow.accessibilityFocusedUIElement once before the full walk
method.baseline_implementation: ViewAccessible.focusChild resolves children() and inspects visible child states.
method.candidate_implementation: Temporary monkeypatch resolves actual native editor or focused current visible cell directly, with bounded cell-token cache; no scan of every accessible cell state.
method.dependency_scope: Compiled Objective-C helper is only a one-off local benchmark artifact, not a runtime or bundled dependency.
method.reproduction_note: The baseline used pre-fix accessibility.py. Running baseline mode against the current fixed source will not recreate that old implementation. The final repository native smoke uses public objc_msgSend without clang/dylib.

rejected_sleep_zero_experiment.decision: No demonstrated native latency improvement, so no production yielding change was made.
rejected_sleep_zero_experiment.limitation: These preliminary runs used a non-activated table; do not mix them with the active-focus comparison.

limits.timing_scope: Worker elapsed timings include simultaneous AX traversal and scheduling contention. They are not a pure compute overhead benchmark.
limits.baseline_second_walk: Worker completed during that walk and table focus was no longer held; the first active baseline walk is the relevant busy comparison.
limits.memory_and_disk_note: Not measured in this focused latency probe.
limits.external_cua: Pending separate manual bundled-app validation by the root agent.
